root: ^(dismissive) Oh, Henry, dear, you know how much I dislike you calling me that.
^And YOU know how much I dislike you calling me Henry.
^Well, fine. (Both chuckle.) It’s been too long, darling. And to answer your question, I’m absolutely dreadful.
^Don Pappardelle was known for his exports and exterminations, not for being a good husband. Trouble in paradise?
^... I found the other woman. Some poor, sweet twenty-something. When I heard, I nearly chucked my pocketbook into the river.

Surprised: ^Can’t be surprised,of course. But it hurts, all the same... I had a life before the Don, you know.
^Do I ever! I remember when every club promoter in the city would saw a leg off to hear you sing.
^And now... look at me! I’m washed up! He’s gotta pay. Hank? Will you do me a favor? (A beat. The grisly implication of her request hangs in the air.)
